Source: [plugins/cilium/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/plugins/cilium/doc.go).

Package cilium projects Cilium CNI state onto Kubernetes Pods and Nodes and normalizes Hubble flows into telemetry events. It does not model Cilium service mesh, Envoy configuration, or L7 policy.

<span id="hdr-Inputs"></span>

## Inputs

The plugin opens no Kubernetes watch. It declares Pods and Nodes as required and CiliumNetworkPolicy, CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy, CiliumEndpoint, and CiliumNode as optional capabilities, consuming them through the Kubernetes plugin's per-GVR and resource-coverage collections.

<span id="hdr-Identity_and_graph_output"></span>

## Identity and graph output

Cilium objects keep their Kubernetes identities (kubernetes.io/v1 Object, cluster authority, apiVersion/kind/UID key). CiliumEndpoint and CiliumNode enrich the Pod and Node with the same namespace and name, because Cilium references them by name, instead of creating competing identities; missing or ambiguous matches produce diagnostics and no facet. The "cni-semantics" contribution emits governed-by from selected Pods to Cilium policies and cilium-cni-policy and cilium-cni facets. Policies with L7 rules contribute no rule counts or relationships. Evidence IDs match the Kubernetes plugin's upsert event IDs.

Publication waits for both the object and coverage collections to reach a coherent generation. Unexpected subscription closure publishes a degraded replacement from the last coherent cache and returns an error.

<span id="hdr-Telemetry"></span>

## Telemetry

The unexported normalizeHubbleFlow maps one Hubble flow to a telemetry event with the original timestamp, a provider or content-derived retry-stable event ID, and Pod UID or network-destination endpoint claims, and ingestHubbleFlow submits it to the shared pipeline, which commits raw events before any graph rollup. No Hubble Relay transport or resumable cursor is included yet, so nothing calls them outside tests.

The package also implements the cilium-network-policy/v1 remediation action, which declares ingress isolation for a Pod with a CiliumNetworkPolicy.

See docs/plugins/cilium.md.
